summary.headline: Lunar Omens in Scorpio and Sagittarius
summary.text: Astrological prognostications for the Moon in Scorpio and Sagittarius at the rising of Sirius, covering plague, disease, weather, famine, prices, warfare, political upheaval, deaths, exile, agriculture, and regional fortunes in Egypt, Iraq, Armenia, Fars, the Maghreb, Nubia, Arabia, and the Levant.
